description: Utility functions for stack trace filtering, error serialization, file path handling, module resolution, and attachment management within the Playwright testing framework.

methods.name: filterStackTrace
methods.description: Filters and formats an error's stack trace, optionally including causes and debug info.

methods.name: filterStackFile
methods.description: Determines whether a file path should be included in filtered stack traces based on environment variables.

methods.name: filteredStackTrace
methods.description: Processes raw stack trace lines into filtered StackFrame objects.

methods.name: serializeError
methods.description: Converts an error or value into a serialized form suitable for reporting.

methods.name: parseLocationArg
methods.description: Parses a string argument into a file location object with optional line and column.

methods.name: createFileFiltersFromArguments
methods.description: Creates file filters from command-line arguments.

methods.name: createFileMatcherFromArguments
methods.description: Creates a file path matcher function from command-line arguments.

methods.name: createFileMatcher
methods.description: Creates a matcher function for file paths based on patterns or regexes.

methods.name: createTitleMatcher
methods.description: Creates a matcher for string titles based on regex patterns.

methods.name: mergeObjects
methods.description: Merges multiple objects into one, with later objects overriding earlier ones.

methods.name: forceRegExp
methods.description: Converts a string pattern into a RegExp object, supporting slash-delimited patterns.

methods.name: relativeFilePath
methods.description: Returns a relative file path from the current working directory.

methods.name: formatLocation
methods.description: Formats a Location object into a string with relative path, line, and column.

methods.name: errorWithFile
methods.description: Creates an Error object with a message including a relative file path.

methods.name: expectTypes
methods.description: Checks if a value is of one of the specified types, throws if not.

methods.name: trimLongString
methods.description: Trims a string to a specified length, appending a hash-based suffix if truncated.

methods.name: addSuffixToFilePath
methods.description: Adds a suffix before the file extension in a file path.

methods.name: sanitizeFilePathBeforeExtension
methods.description: Sanitizes a file path before its extension, optionally with a specified extension.

methods.name: getContainedPath
methods.description: Returns an absolute path within a parent directory if contained.

methods.name: getPackageJsonPath
methods.description: Recursively finds the nearest package.json path for a folder, with caching.

methods.name: resolveReporterOutputPath
methods.description: Resolves the output path for reporters based on config and package.json location.

methods.name: normalizeAndSaveAttachment
methods.description: Saves an attachment file or buffer to disk, returning its info.

methods.name: fileIsModule
methods.description: Determines if a file is an ES module based on extension or package.json type.

methods.name: resolveImportSpecifierAfterMapping
methods.description: Resolves module import paths, considering directory index and extension substitution.

methods.name: fileExistsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously checks if a file exists.

methods.name: removeDirAndLogToConsole
methods.description: Removes a directory and logs the removal to console.
